subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

For Rana, unable to see a thing, the __parade __seemed to last forever.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"parade"** means a public procession, especially one celebrating a special day or event. (रैली या जुलूस)

 
 
• **Example: **The city organizes a grand **parade** every year to celebrate Independence Day.
 
 
 
• **"Procession"** refers to a number of people or vehicles moving forward in an orderly fashion, especially as part of a ceremony. (जुलूस)
 
 
• **Example: **The wedding **procession** moved slowly through the streets, followed by a band playing traditional music.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'parade'** is **'procession'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hiding** (छिपना): The action of concealing someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** The cat is hiding under the bed, afraid of the thunderstorm.
 
 
 
• **Darkness** (अंधकार): The partial or total absence of light.
 
 
• **Example: **Darkness filled the room as soon as the lights went out.
 
 
 
• **Concealment** (छिपाव): The action of hiding something or preventing it from being known.
 
 
• **Example:** The concealment of evidence led to a miscarriage of justice.

The correct answer is: Option 1.&l
